title: Sicut lilum (Palestrina)
desc: Giovanni Pierluigi da Palestrina, Sicut lilum. 5 voices (Cantus, Altus, Tenor, Quintus, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Model_0048); edited by Vincent Besson, Kévin Roger, Richard Freedman, Pothárn Imre. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
